name: 2.9.18 - Fill Buffalo page fixes
notes: Fixes from the first try of Fill Buffalo page on the RDP PC. The line under the Invoice tab's buttons (waiting for a Buffalo page, and why nothing was filled) was cut off: the buttons are now in two rows and the card makes room for long lines at any window width. Tempe Buffalo Fill 1.0.1: a copy without its key (pair.json) now says so and names the folder to load instead; a failed check of the Buffalo page now says why, with Chrome's version, on its button and on the helper's line, and goes to the day log, as does how each fill ended. After this update, in Chrome on the RDP PC, once per Windows user: chrome://extensions, Remove any Tempe Buffalo Fill, then Load unpacked and paste %LOCALAPPDATA%\TempeMobileCostar\BuffaloFill into the folder box. The read, the Buffalo rules and Copy Buffalo Details are as 2.9.17. Nothing is sold or saved in COSTAR, nothing is saved in Buffalo; Sold stays disabled. Not yet tried on the live Buffalo page. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
